changelog:
**ClawMate v2.7.2 — Major Refactor & Focus Shift**

- Completely reworked skill: now dedicated to file management, project plans, and feedback workflows instead of companion AI functionality.
- All previous companion logic, persona files, and memory/relationship systems removed.
- New documentation in SKILL.md describes command-line usage, project initialization, archiving, and best practices.
- Added LICENSE.txt (MIT) and structured metadata in _meta.json.
- Now recommends integration with other work skills for project workflow phases.
- Users must now configure a trusted CLAWMATE_URL context for security; all file operations are local and use ClawMate’s API.
summary: ClawMate 文件管理 + 预览 + 反馈闭环 + 项目管理。支持文件搜索预览、feedback 处理、项目初始化与前期梳理（Phase I-V）。GitHub: https://github.com/updatedb/clawmate
